blocks.content: Quiz: What is the condition of method overriding?
Tap an option below to answer:
One class should inherit another class.
For method overriding, there should exist inheritance between classes.
For method overriding, there should exist inheritance between classes.
The same method should be present in both the parent class and the child class.
The name, return type and parameters should be the same in both the parent and child class.
The name, return type and parameters should be the same in both the parent and child class.
Both the options are the correct answer.
Both the options are the correct answer.
Only one of the above options is the correct answer.
Only one of the above options is the correct answer.
